name: Contact Form Entries Database
author: ColorWhistle

sections.description:
This plugin helps you store and manage form submissions from popular form plugins like:
– Contact Form 7
– WPForms
– Ninja Forms

You can:
– Capture all form entries automatically
– View, filter, and search submissions in the WordPress dashboard
– Export entries for further analysis
– Keep data safe in your database

Useful for websites where form submissions must be logged or backed up.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/contact-form-entries-database directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the �Plugins� screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Form Entries > Settings to select which form plugins to track.
sections.faq:
Does it store submissions from all forms?

It stores submissions from Contact Form 7, WPForms, and Ninja Forms if enabled in settings.

Where can I view the submissions?

Go to the Form Entries menu in your WordPress admin.

Is the data stored securely?

Yes, all entries are stored securely in your WordPress database.
